requirements.text: Preserve the authentic lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark (orange 'sleepy' and charcoal 'head' with the integrated closed-eye 'ee' motif) and the digital 'ee' monogram in their permitted variants, proportions and clear space without rotation, stretching, drop shadows, bevel/emboss, or unapproved recolouring.

Use the supplied primary palette of Vermilion/Giants Orange (#F15A22, RGB 241,90,34) and Charcoal/Metal Grey (#414042, RGB 65,64,66). For Titanium/Classic White, RGB 255,255,255 implies #FFFFFF while the printed hex #231F20 is a dark-colour conflict; never use #231F20 as white and treat #FFFFFF as an RGB-based interpretation pending source correction.

Place copy and logos on real architectural wall/backdrop space with natural high contrast; do not use artificial patches, haze, blur masks or fades to rescue legibility, even though guideline excerpt S09 mentions a transparent patch.

When a product is featured, lock product identity, colour, fabric/pattern, proportions, construction and claims strictly to official Sleepyhead SKU evidence; never transfer furniture designs, fabrics, logos, slogans or durability/efficacy claims from the Pinterest inspiration board or third-party stills.

Follow the supplied typography specification naming Migrena Grotesque for brand communications (Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold and italics) and Source Sans Pro for web (Light, Regular, Semibold, Bold and italics), without claiming licensed Migrena Grotesque binaries are installed or treating sample serif headlines as a replacement brand rule.

preferences.text: Express a human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky and fabulous Jester personality using humorous, informal, witty and personable language that builds connection and enjoyment while staying clear, useful and free of unsupported product promises.

Draw selectively from the supplied complementary palette (#004F2D, #D87CAC, #FFDA22, #ACBDBA, #FFDCCC, #531CB3, #404796, #06D6A0, #610345, #BDD358, #3FA7D6, #FFBE0B, #D741A7, #8B9474, #00A878, #5E0B15, #944BBB, #FEEA00, #08A045) to support coherent room themes without using every colour at once or recolouring the logo or SKU.

Treat the whole room as the unit of inspiration—balancing pale or tonal architectural shells, selective colour zoning, readable patterns (stripes, dots, checkerboards, waves), rounded silhouettes, timber/tactile grounding, natural daylight and lived-in resident activities across either expressive rooms (e.g., P001, P022) or quieter colour-aware spaces (e.g., P076).

In social posts and compact profile contexts, favour the simplified closed-eye 'ee' monogram kept prominent, legible and unobscured without crowding the composition, respecting context-specific icon sizing (32x32 app icon vs 16x16 favicon).

Official website captures show Sleepyhead's broad Indian home-comfort catalogue (mattresses, beds, sofas, sofabeds, recliners, furniture, pillows) alongside festive promotional banners and bank offers; treat promotional styling and partner badges as campaign-specific site observations rather than permanent brandbook rules.

visualRules.value: Primary palette specifies Vermilion/Giants Orange HEX #F15A22 (RGB 241,90,34; CMYK 0,80,100,0) and Charcoal/Metal Grey HEX #414042 (RGB 65,64,66; CMYK 0,0,0,90). Titanium/Classic White is specified as RGB 255,255,255 / CMYK 0,0,0,0 but misprinted as HEX #231F20; never use #231F20 as white and retain #FFFFFF as an RGB interpretation pending correction.

Complementary palette codes supplied for supporting use within a coherent theme: #004F2D, #D87CAC, #FFDA22, #ACBDBA, #FFDCCC, #531CB3, #404796, #06D6A0, #610345, #BDD358, #3FA7D6, #FFBE0B, #D741A7, #8B9474, #00A878, #5E0B15, #944BBB, #FEEA00, #08A045.

Brand typeface is Migrena Grotesque (Regular, Regular Italic, Medium, Medium Italic, Semi bold, Semi bold Italic, Bold, Bold Italic). Web typeface is Source Sans Pro (Light, Light Italic, Regular, Regular Italic, Semi bold, Semi bold Italic, Bold, Bold Italic).

Use the authentic lowercase 'sleepyhead' wordmark (orange 'sleepy', charcoal 'head', closed-eye 'ee' motif) or closed-eye 'ee' digital monogram in permitted variants (master, reverse on orange/black, single-colour, positive/negative, greyscale, outline). Preserve proportions and e-based clear space; do not rotate, stretch, bevel/emboss, drop-shadow, recolour, or place over low-contrast/busy patterns. Retain context-specific digital sizes (32x32 app icon vs 16x16 favicon).
Reserve real architectural wall or backdrop space for copy and logo legibility; artificial patches, haze, blur masks and fades are prohibited despite S09's transparent-patch suggestion.

Product appearance, colour, upholstery/fabric, proportions and features must match official Sleepyhead SKU evidence; never substitute or alter SKU attributes based on guideline application photos or Pinterest inspiration imagery.

preserve: Lowercase Sleepyhead master wordmark ('sleepy' in orange #F15A22, 'head' in charcoal #414042 with the closed-eye 'ee' motif) and permitted authentic logo/monogram variants
Primary brand colours (#F15A22 orange, #414042 charcoal, and RGB 255,255,255 white while flagging the printed #231F20 hex conflict)
Named typography hierarchy: Migrena Grotesque for brand and Source Sans Pro for web
Human-centred, youthful, witty, informal Jester brand personality focused on connection and everyday enjoyment
Real architectural copy/logo space with natural contrast and physically plausible lighting, scale and circulation
Strict separation between official Sleepyhead SKU product facts and advisory spatial inspiration
explore: Whole-room domestic settings inspired by the supplied spatial families: bright expressive apartments (e.g., P001), compact connected open-plan homes (e.g., P022), pastel sculptural rooms, retro graphic living spaces, cosy reading corners, playful bedrooms and quieter botanical/tonal alternatives (e.g., P076)
Selective combinations of the primary palette and complementary palette accents across wall zones, rugs, lamps and art within a coherent room theme
Controlled pattern play (stripes, dots, checkerboards, waves) on a single chosen layer balanced by tactile wood, woven or matte surfaces
Inhabited, relatable domestic moments (reading, music, lounging, socialising) with natural daylight and practical lamps
avoid: Using the misprinted hex #231F20 as Titanium/Classic White
Adding artificial patches, translucent boxes, haze, blur masks or gradient fades behind copy or logos
Distorting, rotating, recolouring, redrawing or adding drop shadows/bevels to the Sleepyhead wordmark or 'ee' monogram

Copying third-party furniture designs, neon wall slogans (e.g., 'I'M SO HAPPY YOU'RE HERE', 'SOUL'), artworks, or competitor brands/claims (e.g., Sofology, Stressless, Four Hands/Crypton) from reference pins
Treating Pinterest reference furniture or sample guideline lifestyle photos as actual Sleepyhead SKU evidence or efficacy proof
Overloading a single room with every complementary colour, chaotic unedited novelty props, or impossible AI architectural geometry

Official correction from the brand for the S14 Titanium/Classic White hex misprint (RGB 255,255,255 vs printed HEX #231F20) and resolution of the S10 icon minimum-size discrepancy (32x32 app icon vs 16x16 favicon)

Production vector artwork files for the Sleepyhead wordmark and 'ee' monogram, plus licensed font binaries for Migrena Grotesque (Source Sans Pro TTF files are uploaded, but uploading alone does not install them in image generation)

guide.decisionSummary: Sleepyhead's reusable execution guide anchors on the supplied guideline excerpts (S01–S15) and official site evidence: preserve the lowercase closed-eye 'ee' identity, primary palette (#F15A22 orange, #414042 charcoal, and RGB 255,255,255 white while isolating the #231F20 print error), named typefaces (Migrena Grotesque and Source Sans Pro), and witty, human-centred Jester voice. Use the supplied Pinterest spatial research (P001–P102) strictly as whole-room architectural, lighting and colour-zoning inspiration—never as SKU product evidence or third-party prop/claim permission—and always reserve real architectural backdrop space for copy and logos rather than artificial patches or fades.
